scales.card: analytical scenario only (compute vs bandwidth roofline with barriers and imbalance); never one-core throughput x cores
scales.core: implemented: 1-4 in-order contexts, U/V pairing rules, same-context issue spacing, round-robin picker, x87 stack with physical-register dependencies, AGI, demand-miss stalls, nonblocking prefetch, outstanding-miss limit, L1/L2 LRU line tracking, optional first-level DTLB, streaming L2 hardware prefetcher and per-core memory service sub-models, gather/scatter/x87/L2-prefetch occupancy
scales.instruction: implemented: latency/pipe class per supported mnemonic (capabilities table), exact functional semantics where 'functional' is true
scales.pair: analytical scenario only (two cores exchanging lines over the ring); needs core-scale cycles and transfer counts as parameters
scales.region: implemented: function or loop regions from GCC-KNC assembly (scripts/from_gcc_s.py) or hand-written records, 1-4 contexts; functional execution, timing, bounds, exhaustive reorder search (<= 12 instructions)
scales.ring: simulated: same detailed unit with synthetic previous-epoch symmetry background; all results unvalidated scenario estimates
scales.unit: simulated: 1-8 detailed cores in lockstep, private caches, 61-position ring, 64 TDs, 8 controllers/16 channels; assumed maps and queues, background off by default

target: Intel Xeon Phi Knights Corner (K1OM, IMCI). Not Knights Landing, not AVX-512, not an out-of-order x86 model.
